凌澈看着干干净净的浴室，开心得像个二百斤的孩子。

要知道，现在的水资源早就被污染了，不要说饮用了，就连碰一下都有被感染的风险，什么过滤烧开都没用。

现在他们能够饮用的水源就只有那些末世之前的瓶装水了。

如此珍贵的水资源，平时喝一口都要计算着来，就更不要说干别的事情了。

凌澈打开水龙头，干净的水流瞬间从花洒喷洒而出，淋了他一身，但凌澈却丝毫不在意，脸上的笑容都快要裂到耳朵根了。

“是水，真的是水，而且是干净的水。”

凌澈直接将身上那身脏兮兮的衣服脱下来，然后痛痛快快地洗了一个澡，即便是没有任何的洗护用品，但他还是很开心。

他并没有穿已经脏掉的衣服，只裹了一件浴巾就从浴室里面走出来了，他这边刚一出来，凌墨便迫不及待地走进了浴室，没一会儿的功夫，浴室里面就响起了哗啦啦的水声。

两人洗完澡之后，换了一身干净的衣服，之前的狼狈瞬间消失不见，虽然他们的下巴还挂着胡茬，但跟之前相比简直判若两人。

很快，两个小时过去了。兄弟两人几乎是掐着时间出门，刚一推开门，就看到同样焕然一新的凌夕，此时她的头上多了一顶黑色的鸭舌帽，用来遮住自己过短的头发。

凌墨凌澈兄弟二人看着妹妹头顶的帽子，顿时便明白了这是怎么回事，眼神中闪过一抹心疼。

“小妹，放心吧，哥哥一定会成功觉醒异能，然后保护你了。”

听到大哥这么说，凌夕的眼中闪过一抹淡淡的笑意，说道：“大哥，我相信你，不过我可不想做温室里面的花朵，拖你们的后腿，等以后晶核足够了，我也要觉醒异能，然后跟你们并肩战斗。”

凌墨凌澈兄弟二人听到凌夕的话，脸上都带着欣慰的笑，这个世界上只剩下他们兄妹三人相依为命，如今小妹能够振作起来，他们很开心。

Ling Che looked at the clean bathroom and was as happy as a 200-pound child.

You know, today's water resources have long been polluted. Not to mention drinking it, even touching it has the risk of infection, and no filtering or boiling is of any use.

The only water source they can drink now is bottled water from before the end of the world.

With such precious water resources, you have to calculate every sip you take, let alone do other things.

Ling Che turned on the faucet, and clean water instantly sprayed out from the showerhead, drenching him all over. But Ling Che didn't care at all, and the smile on his face was almost to the point of breaking his ears.

"It's water, really water, and it's clean water."

Ling Che took off his dirty clothes and took a quick shower. Even though he didn't have any toiletries, he was still very happy.

He did not wear dirty clothes, only wrapped in a bath towel and walked out of the bathroom. As soon as he came out, Ling Mo couldn't wait to walk into the bathroom. After a while, the sound of rushing water could be heard in the bathroom.

After the two took a shower, they changed into clean clothes. The previous embarrassment disappeared instantly. Although there was still stubble hanging on their chins, they were completely different from before.

Soon, two hours passed.The two brothers almost squeezed the time to go out. As soon as they opened the door, they saw Ling Xi who also looked brand new. At this time, she had a black peaked cap on her head to cover her too short hair.

The two brothers Ling Mo and Ling Che looked at the hat on their sister's head and immediately understood what was going on, with a flash of distress in their eyes.

"Little sister, don't worry, my brother will successfully awaken his powers and protect you."

Hearing what her elder brother said, a faint smile flashed in Ling Xi's eyes and she said, "Brother, I believe you, but I don't want to be a flower in the greenhouse and hold you back. When the crystal cores are enough in the future, I will also awaken my powers and fight alongside you."

When the two brothers Ling Mo and Ling Che heard Ling Xi's words, they both had happy smiles on their faces. They were the only three brothers and sisters left in the world to depend on each other. Now that their little sister can cheer up, they are very happy.
